# 全仓lint有历史债致Vue变更单独eslint
苏州市房地产监测V3 的 zhi2-web-admin 因仓库存在大量历史 lint 问题未跑全仓 lint，对涉及 Vue 文件单独执行 eslint。

## 背景与约束
- 仓库既有大量历史 lint 问题，故未跑全仓 lint
- 项目无 typecheck 脚本

## 单独审查结果
- 对 detail.vue、changeDetail.vue、index.vue、ExtractDialog.vue、BuildingForm.vue 单独 eslint 无新增错误
- BuildingForm.vue 实属 `buildingTable/` 而非 `buildinginfo/`
- 仅有 `vue/html-indent` 与 `prefer-zs-components` 既有告警
- 审查结论 Warning，合并前需确认业务与后端

## 涉及文件
- `buildingTable/components/BuildingForm.vue`、`buildinginfo/changeDetail.vue`、`buildinginfo/detail.vue`
- `buildinginfo/components/modifyForm.vue`、`buildinginfo/index.vue`、`buildinginfo/components/ExtractDialog.vue`
- `package.json`

## 验证与归属
- 验证证据：src=苏州市房地产监测V3/256.md
- 来源会话ID：eda148ea-5077-4e6e-a126-ed8b88e4742b
- 所属项目：苏州市房地产监测V3；代码基线：none

- 根因：ResizeObserver 触发布局同步调用 `updateNavIndicator({animate:false})` 与菜单切换 `$nextTick` 更新抢同一帧，无过渡更新覆盖过渡动画
- 关键修复：区分 layoutOnly 位置同步与 activeMenuItemPath 监听（始终允许过渡）
- 切换后 400ms 内保留过渡动画
- 使用双 `requestAnimationFrame` 提交上一帧位置
- `isActive` 用 `normalizeMenuPath` 归一化路径
- 涉及文件：layout/components/Navbar.vue、styles/variables.css

# Limite de nome de pessoa jurídica em 30 caracteres
O frontend não limitava o comprimento do nome do representante legal, disparando erro 400 do backend ao exceder 30 caracteres; a correção principal ficou em Step2LegalPerson.

## Causa raiz
- Frontend não aplicava limite de comprimento no nome do representante legal
- Backend retornava erro 400 para nomes acima de 30 caracteres

## Solução
- Input Vue com maxlength="30", show-word-limit, v-model.trim e regra {min:2,max:30}
- register-helpers.js define REGISTER_MAX_LENGTH_FIELDS
- Step2 altera max do nome de 150 para 30

## Arquivos envolvidos
- src/utils/registerValidate.js e views/register/components/Step2LegalPerson.vue
- views/register/companyRegister.vue e e2e/fixtures/register-helpers.js
- views/institution/company/index.vue e e2e/register/company-register-fields.spec.js
- views/institutionRegister/components/Step2AdminInfo.vue e views/register/components/Step1CompanyInfo.vue

## Verificação
- Evidência: src=苏州市房地产监测V3-leftover/055.md; Sessão: e3d71734-ab93-48dc-b3f5-54b9eddd55be

# 企业注册法人姓名长度限制为30字符
苏州市房地产监测V3 的 zhi2-web-admin 在企业注册页对法人姓名输入框增加长度限制，避免超长提交触发后端 400 错误。

## 问题根因
- 前端未对法人姓名输入框限制长度
- 后端对超过 30 字符的法人姓名返回 400 错误

## 修复方案
- Vue 输入框增加 `maxlength="30"` 与 `show-word-limit`，使用 `v-model.trim` 去除空格
- 校验规则设为 `{ min: 2, max: 30 }` 拦截超长提交
- `e2e/fixtures/register-helpers.js` 的 `REGISTER_MAX_LENGTH_FIELDS.step2` 中法人姓名 max 由 150 改为 30

## 涉及文件
- `src/utils/registerValidate.js` 与 `views/register/components/Step2LegalPerson.vue`
- `views/register/companyRegister.vue` 与 `e2e/fixtures/register-helpers.js`
- `views/institution/company/index.vue` 与 `e2e/register/company-register-fields.spec.js`
- `views/institutionRegister/components/Step2AdminInfo.vue` 与 `views/register/components/Step1CompanyInfo.vue`
